integrity: The exact maximum and the count of 980 maxima are independently regenerated and also agree with published results. The structural assertion is the complete orbit decomposition under the explicitly defined natural symmetry group, with independent canonicalization and invariant fingerprints.
scientific_limitations: The classification is finite and concerns only \(C_7\boxtimes C_7\). It does not improve the Shannon capacity of \(C_7\) and does not assert that the explicit order-\(392\) natural group is the full automorphism group.
title: Three symmetry types of maximum two-use zero-error codes for the \(7\)-cycle channel
